title: Max Frequency of K After One Segment Add

reported.text: Choose one segment and a value D to add to (or subtract from) every element in it, once. Maximize how many elements equal K. Same OA: a 'virtual odd/even' number difference problem using set-bit counts.

sources.passage:
Myntra OA | SSE | 2023
Question:
given n as input you need to find the below result 

	Math.abs((nth actual odd  + nth actual even ) - (nth virtual odd + nth virtual even))

where
actual odd -> n % 2 != 0
actual even -> n % 2 == 0

virtual even -> whose only 2 bits are set (ex 3 -> 011)
virtual odd -> whose only 3 bits are set (ex 7 -> 111)


Question2:
Mike has an integer array of length N on which he can perform the following
operations:
1. From the given array he can choose any segment (i, j) such that 1 <= i <= j <= n
2. He also has to choose an optimal value D in such a way that he can add D to all the elements
in the selected segment or subtract D from all the elements in the selected segment or do nothing.

Given a value K, your task is to help MIke find and return the maximum frequency of K after performing a full operation on the entire array only once.

INput:
input1: an Integer N denoting the length of the array
input2 : An integer value K.
input3: An array of N integers.

Output: Return maximum frequency of K after one operation in the array

Ex:
5
2
{6,6,2,6,6}

output: 4

Myntra Ramp Up Interview Experience | 6-month SDE Internship | Selected
Recently went through the interview process for the 6-Month SDE Internship at Myntra through Myntra Ramp Up.

## Process
- OA (SmartHire on Unstop)
- Technical Round 1
- Technical Round 2

---

# OA

### Format
- 15 MCQs
- 2 Coding Questions

Difficulty: Easy-Medium to Medium

### MCQ Topics
- OOPs
- DBMS
- C++/Python fundamentals
- Distributed Systems
- GenAI/LLM basics

### Coding Question 1
Largest Rectangle in Histogram variant.

Given:
- building heights
- integer M
- remove exactly one building

Need maximum rectangle area ≤ M.

Concepts:
- Monotonic Stack
- Histogram Area

### Coding Question 2
Array sorting + manipulation based problem.

Concepts:
- Sorting
- Greedy/Array Manipulation

---

# Technical Round 1

### Question 1
Minimum swaps required to bring all elements <= K together.

Concepts:
- Sliding Window
- Counting bad elements

### Question 2
Find the smallest number consisting only of 0 and 1 divisible by n.

Concepts:
- BFS
- Modular Arithmetic

---

# Technical Round 2

### Question 1
Minimum route reversals required so all warehouses can reach warehouse 0.

Concepts:
- Graph Traversal
- DFS/BFS
- Edge Direction Tracking

### Question 2
Server Cluster Load Balancer problem.

Given:
- RAM usage
- start time
- end time

Determine whether RAM usage exceeds total capacity.

Concepts:
- Difference Array
- Prefix Sum
- Sweep Line

There was also a short discussion on my resume and projects.

---

# Overall Experience

- Interviewers were friendly and discussion-oriented
- Focus was mainly on:
  - problem-solving
  - optimization
  - communication
  - clarity of thought

---

# Result

Selected for the 6-Month SDE Internship at Myntra.

Hi everyone, I’d like to share my interview experience for the **SDE-1 (Backend) role** at Myntra in **December 2024**. This was part of a hiring drive, and there were a total of 3+1 rounds . I’ll go through each round in detail, hoping it helps others preparing for similar opportunities.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![]()

**How did i get the opportunity?**

I received a call from a recruiter after filling out a **Google form** posted on LinkedIn around **mid-december 2024**.

**Round 0 : Online Assessment — 1 hr 15 minutes**

This was conducted over tests.mett platform. There were three questions , one was easy and other two were leetcode medium level difficulty.

**Result:**  
After **two days**, I received a call from the recruiter informing me that I had cleared the round and would proceed to the next stage.

**Round 1: Problem Solving & Data Structures — 60 Minutes (Offline)**

This round happened at the Myntra Office. It consisted of **two DSA questions** (LeetCode medium-level), which were pretty standard.

**Problem 1**: Find median in a stream of running integers.

**Problem 2**: find minimum operations to convert string S1 (e.g., comb ) to S2 ( e.g., cat), given you can perform two operations: delete a character and replace a character.

The **expectation** was to **write code** for both problems and dry run over a test case within **60 minutes**.

**Result:**  
After some 15 minutes recruiter told me that I had cleared this round.

**Round 2: Problem Solving & Data Structures — 60 Minutes (Offline)**

In this round i was asked three DSA questions, it is similar to the first one.

**Problem 1**: Find second smallest number in an array in less than O(n) time.

**Problem 2:** Given an array where each element is a pair represents a balloon’s position. When you shoot a balloon of a range, all other balloons that are within its range (i.e., overlapping it) will also pop.  
Find the **minimum number of arrows** needed to pop all the balloons.

e.g., i/p = [[1,6], [2,8], [7,12], [10,16]], o/p=2

**Problem 3:** I dont remember the exact questions, it was something related to trie, some strings are there, implement a google search type functionality.
